# Jawab24

> Arabic-first AI auto-reply platform for Facebook, Instagram, Shopify, and Salla businesses.

Jawab24 (Arabic: جواب24) is an AI-powered customer support automation tool built for Arabic-speaking and bilingual businesses. It automatically replies to Facebook comments, Instagram DMs, and Messenger messages in Arabic and English, 24/7.

## Key Facts

- Website: https://jawab24.com
- Platforms: Facebook Pages, Instagram Business, Shopify, Salla
- Languages: Arabic (6 dialect families) + English, full RTL interface
- Reply system: 3-layer (Template Replies + AI Smart Replies + Away Messages)
- AI accuracy: 99.6% across 125 real-world evaluation scenarios
- E-commerce: Syncs product catalogs from Shopify and Salla with automatic price verification
- Pricing: Free trial (no credit card) → Starter → Business → Pro plans
- Mobile: Android app with push notifications (iOS coming soon)

## What Makes Jawab24 Different

1. Arabic-first: Understands Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi dialects and Franco-Arabic
2. Salla integration: Only auto-reply tool with native Salla e-commerce support
3. Price hallucination detection: 2-tier verification ensures AI never invents prices
4. Confidence scoring: Low-confidence replies are held for human review
5. Knowledge Base with RAG: AI answers only from your verified business information
6. Template replies at zero AI cost: Keyword-based rules with no per-message charges

## Target Audience

- E-commerce store owners on Shopify or Salla
- Facebook Page managers with high comment/message volume
- Small businesses needing 24/7 customer support without hiring staff
- Arabic-speaking businesses that need tools built for their language
- Social media managers handling multiple pages
